components.name: Primary Contact Button
components.description: Compact solid action for the main contact path.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: #20231f; color: #f7f7f4; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.3rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; font: 500 0.75rem 'Instrument Sans', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #42654c; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #42654c; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Action
components.description: Quiet secondary action used for archive navigation.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { background: #f7f7f4; color: #20231f; border: 1px solid #dedfda; border-radius: 0.3rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; font: 400 0.75rem 'Instrument Sans', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: #eeefeb; } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #42654c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Text-led project link with optional uploaded cover art and plain metadata.
components.html: Project titleA verified description of the work.
components.css: .ds-project { display: grid; gap: 0.75rem; color: #20231f; text-decoration: none; font: 500 1.125rem 'Instrument Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-project-image { display: block; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #dedfda; border-radius: 0.3rem; background: #eeefeb; } .ds-project-summary { color: #656b64; font: 400 0.875rem/1.6 'Instrument Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-project:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #42654c; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-project-image { transition: transform 900ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-project:hover .ds-project-image { transform: scale(1.01); } }

components.name: Primary Navigation Link
components.description: Plain text link with a fine underline for hover and active states.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; color: #20231f; text-decoration: none; font: 400 0.875rem 'Instrument Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -5px; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 350ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page']::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #42654c; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
This portfolio uses an editorial frame that lets verified project listings provide the visual interest. Warm, near-neutral surfaces, thin dividers, and a restrained forest accent keep the interface composed while serif headlines add a human voice. The public site has matching light and dark palettes; its tokens are scoped to `.site-theme` so the separate admin interface can keep its own system.

The layout gives the introduction, selected work, profile, and contact room to breathe. Navigation and contact remain easy to find, while restrained motion supports links and optional imagery without turning the page into a sequence of effects. Imported projects are text-led because the source thumbnails redirect to the new domain; project images can be added in the admin studio.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial serif display paired with a practical sans body face.
Warm-neutral surfaces and a single muted green accent.
Hairline borders and generous section spacing instead of ornament.
Public-site color tokens isolated from admin tokens.

rules.name: The Scoped Public Palette Rule
rules.body: Apply portfolio palette tokens inside `.site-theme`; admin colors are a separate concern.

dos: Do let verified project details carry visual emphasis; use imagery when it is available.
Do add project case-study details only when they are supplied and verified.
Do keep focus states visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do use the dark public palette as the tonal counterpart to the light palette.
donts: Don't add decorative section numbering or eyebrow kickers to public pages.
Don't invent project years, outcomes, testimonials, or detailed case-study claims.
Don't reintroduce the removed grid, grain, marquee, or reveal treatment to public pages.
